subject.title: fix: inject only shared auth into macos dashboard

question: Should the macOS embedded Dashboard browser receive only configured shared gateway tokens, or may it also receive native device/operator tokens for parity with native websocket clients?
rationale: The linked issue and this PR choose shared-token-only browser auth, while the sibling issue and PR choose native-token parity; either choice changes existing Dashboard auth behavior for some users.

options.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
options.body: Proceed with this PR's policy after fixing the endpoint-change path, resolving conflicts, and adding real macOS proof.

options.title: Keep native-token parity
options.body: Pause or close this PR and continue with the sibling Dashboard auth unification direction instead.

options.title: Design an explicit compatibility path
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved design that preserves existing upgrade behavior by default while making stricter shared-token-only behavior explicit and tested.

recommendation.title: Use shared-token-only browser auth
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR's policy after fixing the endpoint-change path, resolving conflicts, and adding real macOS proof.
